source.author: verg
source.text: Ille, ut opes fractae Teucrum, et Fortuna recessit, res Agamemnonias victriciaque arma secutus, fas omne abrumpit; Polydorum obtruncat, et auro vi potitur.
source.text_original: Ille, ut opes fractae Teucrum, et Fortuna recessit, / res Agamemnonias victriciaque arma secutus, / fas omne abrumpit; Polydorum obtruncat, et auro / vi potitur.
source.text_english: When the Teucrians’ resources were broken and Fortune had withdrawn, he, pursuing Agamemnon’s fortunes and his victorious arms, breaks every sacred bond; he cuts down Polydorus and by force gains possession of the gold.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text_english: Does he by force gain possession of the Grecian fleece?
